name: @thirdlight/physics-rapier
description: Thirdlight M2 Rapier 2D physics adapter (docs/contracts/runtime.md §12.6, promoted from physics.md; packet 31): the approved `@dimforge/rapier2d-compat@0.20.0` collision port — async cancellable WASM initialization before runtime start, one `World` per game with static box/convex-polygon colliders, the parentless kinematic character controller (createCharacterController(offset) + computeColliderMovement/computedMovement/setTranslation) with ground snap and collision-result grounding/support normals, per-step correction/support results, diagnostics and idempotent disposal that releases the world. Imports `@thirdlight/runtime` types and the approved Rapier pin only (dependencies.md §4.1/§4.3: no project-model internals, editor, backend, protocol, workspace, three or three-adapter edge; the runtime owns stepping — no second frame driver). Phase 23.0: the `./3d` subpath is the 3D backend on the approved `@dimforge/rapier3d-compat@0.20.0` (the 2D pin's version; decision 0005) implementing the runtime `PhysicsPort3D` — a separate entry so 2D bundles never carry the 3D WASM.
